description: This file defines the LocalizationDao class, which manages database operations related to localization features such as languages, translations, groups, and import errors within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for searching, retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting localization data, as well as handling pagination and filtering.

classes.name: LocalizationDao
classes.description: This class provides data access methods for managing localization-related entities such as languages, translation strings, import errors, and groups in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches for languages based on provided filter parameters and returns an array of language entities.

methods.name: getLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of languages matching the search filter.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns existing language IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: saveI18NLanguage
methods.description: Persists a new or updated I18NLanguage entity.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslations
methods.description: Fetches translations in a normalized array format based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getNormalizedTranslationsForExport
methods.description: Fetches translations formatted for export, including additional metadata.

methods.name: getTranslationsCount
methods.description: Returns count of translations matching filter criteria.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedLangString
methods.description: Saves multiple translation entities, updating existing ones if necessary.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStrings
methods.description: Persists an array of import error records.

methods.name: getImportErrorList
methods.description: Returns a list of import errors based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getImportErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of import errors matching filter criteria.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes import error records for specific language and language string IDs.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLanguageAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Deletes import error records for a specific language and employee number.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Searches for localization groups based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getI18NGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the count of groups matching search filter.

methods.name: deleteI18NLanguage
methods.description: Marks specified languages as removed by updating their 'added' status.

methods.name: getLangStringById
methods.description: Retrieves a language string entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLangStringByUnitIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Finds a language string entity by its unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves an error entity by its name.

methods.name: getI18NGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves a group entity by its name.
